notes: The document does not publish a distribution of retired members by 5-year age band. Exhibit A (pages 36-37) provides only aggregate totals for 'Retired members' (3,676 count, $4,886 avg monthly), 'Disabled members' (127 count, $3,605 avg monthly), and 'Beneficiaries' (1,153 count, $2,294 avg monthly) without age breakdowns. Consequently, the target grid for 'Retirement' distribution by age band is unavailable. The transcribed tables are archived as evidence of the available aggregate data.
